correctness.rationale: Verified finite simple cubic ladder definition on 2n vertices, n≥3, with last-to-first twist. Exact FO quantifier rank four is described by T0 atomic diagrams and T_{r+1} as the set of all one-vertex extension T_r types, including equality/repeated choices; by induction this captures both existential and universal rank-four formulas. Reconstructed the radius-two local-window argument: for n≥16 no 4-round type depends on long wrap or the twist, giving a common eventual type. Reimplemented an exact finite type recursion independently of package code for every n=3..16 and both twists (28 graphs): found exactly 12 different low-n theories and a single identical common type for n=9..16; no low-n type equals it. The n≥16 uniform locality proof bridges the unbounded part. The maximum minimum representative size within these families is therefore 18, reached by n=9. Finite enumeration by itself is not used for the infinite n statement.
